title: About the Author
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR Italo Calvino was born in Cuba in 1923, and grew up in Italy. He was an essayist and journalist and a member of the editorial staff of Einaudi in Turin. His other novels include If on a winter’s night a traveller and The Castle of Crossed Destinies . In 1973 he won the prestigious Premio Feltrinelli. He died in 1985.
